The problem is rarely the technology. It’s that nobody knows which data is the right one.

What changes day to day

  • From data scattered across spreadsheets, email and chat

    to one system where every record has a date and an owner.

  • From a different version of the truth in each area

    to a single source of data, with role-based permissions.

  • From asking who changed what

    to a searchable history of every operation.

How I build it

  • Separation by domain

    Each business area in its own module, with clear boundaries.

  • Access enforced on the server

    Permissions checked on the server, never in the interface.

  • Verified changes

    Routes under test: changes don’t break what works.
